chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, and Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, altogether, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, and Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Abi Baseer, who said:

There is no problem with you increasing [the period] and her increasing [it] when the term is cut off between the two of you. She should say, 'I hereby permit you with another term with agreement from her,' and that is not permissible for other than you, until her waiting period expires.

key_terms.اسْتَحْلَلْتُكِ: I have permitted you / I have made lawful for you

ai.seo_question: How can a husband extend his wife's waiting period after it has expired?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi elucidates the mechanism of 'Taslih' (mutual consent) to extend the 'Iddah beyond its fixed duration, a practice rooted in the flexibility of Shia jurisprudence for reconciliation. It emphasizes that the extension requires the woman's explicit permission and grants the husband exclusive rights during the new term, preventing other suitors from approaching her until the new period concludes.
